_about: The character creator's options (PLAN 2.7b): what the player can choose, per trait, in the order shown.
The UI builds the creator screen from this file; the save stores the look as trait id -> option id
(an unknown or missing id falls back to the trait's first option for that body, never a crash).
tools/blender/build_character.py --creator reads this file and builds every glb and mask it names, so
every option resolves; CreatorLook (game/src/world/office/creator_look.gd) puts a look together.
Traits: an ordered list of {id, label, options} or, for a trait that differs per body, {id, label,
per_body: {m: [...], f: [...]}, any_body}; any_body true means every option of either list may be
chosen on either body (the body's own list is only the default order and comes first).
Options: {id, label (Dutch, as shown), ...} with one of:
model: the body's glb (assets/characters/<model>.glb: skeleton, skin, eyes, brows and the animations
idle, walk, jog, sit, talk); body: m|f (the parts' suffix); pronoun: hij|zij ({hij_zij} in dialogs);
color: [r, g, b] sRGB 0..255 (a tint: the material colour over a shared greyscale texture), or
[r, g, b, a] with a in 0..1 for a see-through glasses frame;
part: a mesh glb on the Head bone, built per body: assets/characters/parts/<part>_<body>.glb; "" is none;
outfit: the clothes, skinned to the body's skeleton: assets/characters/parts/outfit_<outfit>_<body>.glb;
layer: a face layer painted over the skin (stubble, make-up): assets/characters/textures/
face_<layer>_<body>.png is the mask (white where it covers), color its colour, or "hair" for the
chosen hair colour; "" is a bare face.
Tints apply to: huidskleur the skin (the material colour is the tone / 0.92: the skin texture keeps
lips and cheeks around 0.92 of its mean), haarkleur the hair, beard and (x 0.8) the brows, ogen the iris,
bril the glasses' frame (its option colour).
Choice of options: what Dutch people aged 18-35 wear now, a design estimate by the art agent
(2026-10-16), revisit once a year. Skin tones: the Netherlands' real mix, light to dark (Dutch,
Turkish/Moroccan, Indonesian/Hindustani, Afro-Surinamese/Antillean roots); the values are estimates
picked to read under the office light, not measured skin colours. Body sizes: player_m 1.82 m,
player_f 1.69 m, close to the average height of Dutch 20-30 year olds (CBS, rounded).
Dropped from the choices (Merijn's playtest, 2026-10-19: they read wrong; contact sheets
docs/screenshots/creator_hair_*_2026-10-19.png): curtains (Middenscheiding, a helmet of flat cards),
staart (Strakke staart, a bald cap with a loose cone), krullen (Krullen, flat card strips). Their glbs
stay under parts/ for a rebuild; an old save's id falls back to the body's first style.
